title: ProposeFailed payload
description: A model call for schema proposals failed, timed out, answered no valid proposals or found the budget or the instance's daily ceiling spent, the redaction policy refused what the model would be shown, or EKR could not read the store's ontology, or `proposals.jsonl` could not be written. Nothing was applied and no proposal was recorded, except when a line of `proposals.jsonl` could not be written after earlier proposals were applied: those stay applied, the lines before stay written, and the reason names both counts.
